title: Maintain three independent repository identities
userIntent: Register two evaluator-owned secondary repositories and enumerate all three repositories from the isolated registry.

intendedBehavior: Primary, secondary, and tertiary repositories retain distinct registry identities.
behavioralInvariants: Adding repositories does not replace or alias an existing registry entry.
regressionRisks: Registry identity collisions appear when more than two repositories are present.

provenance.note: Shared multi-repository scale behavior anchored to the exact v1.7.2 release.
